name: Arcane Elemental
primary:
A arcane elemental appears in front of you and follows you for 60 s. At most 2 elementals serve you at once: a third one replaces the oldest. It attacks monsters nearby and whoever fights you, and never harms you or your allies.
A floating crystal that fires an arcane ray every 1.3 s from up to 13 blocks. The ray never misses:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ arcane
• Arcane instability for 3 s
self_description: The elemental appears right next to you.
